messages:
maria: heads up — noticed the metrics grid is much slower on EU canary after the routing tweak. LCP jumped from ~620ms to ~3.1s. Charts hang for ~2s when panning :eyes:

dan: saw this too on canary. Stack traces point to a burst of parallel fetches for series tiles. suspect prefetch priority change + TTL reduction triggered heavy main-thread parse. @maria can you paste repro steps?

maria: repro: open Project Foobar -> Metrics -> set range 30d -> click CPU series. UI freezes while several `fetch` calls resolve and we parse many small widgets. Happens consistently.

alex: did we change route-affinity or prefetch limits yesterday? @jules pushed a routing policy tweak, right?

jules: yes i rolled a small route-affinity tweak at 02:13 UTC to reduce cross-region kvprefetch. I didn't expect it to increase bundle/main-thread load though :thinking:

dan: timeline shows the slowdown aligning with the routing update + evictions in kvcache. saw logs like: 

```
sre-bot: evict shard eu-01 bytes=81726145 TTL=120s reason=route-change
client: fetch /api/console/metrics?range=30d&series=heavy
```

pat: also seeing sourcemap-worker CPU spike around the same time — parsing sourcemaps for many tiny chunks is causing main-thread blocking when hydrating charts.

maria: can we revert the route tweak on canary until we have a mitigation? deploy-bot, canary rollback?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback scheduled for canary at 14:25 UTC (deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-21-rc1) :white_check_mark:

alex: quick mitigation suggestion: bump prefetch TTL for metrics grid to 10s and cap concurrent prefetch to 4. That should smooth bursts and reduce simultaneous sourcemap parses. Also consider batching tile fetches by series group.

jules: ack — reverting canary tweak now and will push a TTL+concurrency patch to canary after rollback. rolling back + patching. :hammer:

dan: post-rollback quick check shows LCP returning to ~650ms on canary. We should add telemetry for `client.prefetch.concurrency` and `kvcache.evictions` tagged by route so we can catch this earlier.

maria: agreed. also please add a small stress eval (synthetic 300 concurrent tabs hitting same project) to validate kvcache-affinity heuristics before rollout.

jules: filed INFRA-1427 to track follow-ups (revert audit, TTL patch, telemetry tags, stress harness).

pat: follow-up action: doc prefetch tuning parameters in console README and add canary alert if kvcache-evictions > 50/min for any route.

maria: thanks everyone — good catch. :thumbsup:
